dataflows.name: BronzeToSilver
dataflows.script:
parameters{
     customerP as string ('banking/bronze/customers.json'),
     accountsP as string ('banking/bronze/accounts.csv'),
     branchesP as string ('banking/bronze/branches.csv'),
     transactionsP as string ('banking/bronze/transactions.csv'),
     customerSilverP as string ('banking/silver/customers'),
     accountSilverP as string ('banking/silver/accounts'),
     branchSilverP as string ('banking/silver/branches'),
     transactionSilverP as string ('banking/silver/transactions')
}
source(output(
          city as string,
          customer_id as string,
          customer_segment as string,
          date_of_birth as date,
          email as string,
          first_name as string,
          last_name as string,
          registration_date as date,
          state as string
     ),
     useSchema: false,
     allowSchemaDrift: true,
     validateSchema: true,
     inferDriftedColumnTypes: true,
     ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
     format: 'json',
     fileSystem: 'banking',
     folderPath: 'bronze',
     fileName: 'customers.json',
     documentForm: 'arrayOfDocuments',
     unquotedColumnNames: true) ~> customers
source(output(
          account_id as string,
          customer_id as string,
          account_type as string,
          account_open_date as date,
          account_status as string,
          balance as decimal(10,0),
          branch_id as string
     ),
     useSchema: false,
     allowSchemaDrift: true,
     validateSchema: false,
     ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
     format: 'delimited',
     fileSystem: 'banking',
     folderPath: 'bronze',
     fileName: 'accounts.csv',
     columnDelimiter: ',',
     escapeChar: '\\',
     quoteChar: '\"',
     columnNamesAsHeader: true) ~> accounts
source(output(
          branch_id as string,
          branch_name as string,
          city as string,
          state as string,
          region as string
     ),
     useSchema: false,
     allowSchemaDrift: true,
     validateSchema: false,
     ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
     format: 'delimited',
     fileSystem: 'banking',
     folderPath: 'bronze',
     fileName: 'branches.csv',
     columnDelimiter: ',',
     escapeChar: '\\',
     quoteChar: '\"',
     columnNamesAsHeader: true) ~> branches
source(output(
          transaction_id as string,
          account_id as string,
          transaction_date as date,
          transaction_type as string,
          amount as decimal(10,0),
          payment_method as string,
          merchant as string,
          transaction_status as string
     ),
     useSchema: false,
     allowSchemaDrift: true,
     validateSchema: false,
     ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
     format: 'delimited',
     fileSystem: 'banking',
     folderPath: 'bronze',
     fileName: 'transactions.csv',
     columnDelimiter: ',',
     escapeChar: '\\',
     quoteChar: '\"',
     columnNamesAsHeader: true) ~> transactions
customers derive(first_name = trim(first_name),
          last_name = trim(last_name),
          customer_segment = upper(trim(customer_segment))) ~> derivedCustomer
derivedCustomer filter(!isNull(customer_id)) ~> filterCustomers
accounts derive(account_type = upper(trim(account_type)),
          account_status = upper(trim(account_status)),
          branch_id = trim(branch_id)) ~> derivedAccounts
derivedAccounts filter(!isNull(account_id)
&&
!isNull(customer_id)) ~> filterAccounts
branches derive(branch_id = trim(branch_id),
          branch_name = upper(trim(branch_name)),
          city = upper(trim(city)),
          state = upper(trim(state)),
          region = upper(trim(region))) ~> derivedBranches
derivedBranches filter(!isNull(branch_id)) ~> filterBranches
transactions derive(transaction_id = trim(transaction_id),
          account_id = trim(account_id),
          transaction_type = upper(trim(transaction_type)),
          transaction_status = upper(trim(transaction_status))) ~> derivedTransactions
derivedTransactions filter(!isNull(transaction_id)
&&
!isNull(account_id)) ~> filterTransaction
filterCustomers sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
     validateSchema: false,
     format: 'delta',
     fileSystem: 'banking',
     folderPath: 'silver/customers',
     overwrite: true,
     mergeSchema: false,
     autoCompact: false,
     optimizedWrite: false,
     vacuum: 0,
     deletable: false,
     insertable: true,
     updateable: false,
     upsertable: false,
     umask: 0022,
     preCommands: [],
     postCommands: [],
     skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
     skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> SilverCustomersSink
filterAccounts sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
     validateSchema: false,
     format: 'delta',
     fileSystem: 'banking',
     folderPath: 'silver/accounts',
     overwrite: true,
     mergeSchema: false,
     autoCompact: false,
     optimizedWrite: false,
     vacuum: 0,
     deletable: false,
     insertable: true,
     updateable: false,
     upsertable: false,
     umask: 0022,
     preCommands: [],
     postCommands: [],
     skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
     skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> sinkAccounts
filterBranches sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
     validateSchema: false,
     format: 'delta',
     fileSystem: 'banking',
     folderPath: 'silver/branches',
     overwrite: true,
     mergeSchema: false,
     autoCompact: false,
     optimizedWrite: false,
     vacuum: 0,
     deletable: false,
     insertable: true,
     updateable: false,
     upsertable: false,
     umask: 0022,
     preCommands: [],
     postCommands: [],
     skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
     skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> sinkBranches
filterTransaction sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
     validateSchema: false,
     format: 'delta',
     fileSystem: 'banking',
     folderPath: 'silver/transactions',
     overwrite: true,
     mergeSchema: false,
     autoCompact: false,
     optimizedWrite: false,
     vacuum: 0,
     deletable: false,
     insertable: true,
     updateable: false,
     upsertable: false,
     umask: 0022,
     preCommands: [],
     postCommands: [],
     skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
     skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> sinkTransaction

dataflows.name: SilverToGold
dataflows.script:
source(output(
          city as string,
          customer_id as string,
          customer_segment as string,
          date_of_birth as date,
          email as string,
          first_name as string,
          last_name as string,
          registration_date as date,
          state as string
     ),
     allowSchemaDrift: true,
     validateSchema: false,
     ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
     format: 'delta',
     fileSystem: 'banking',
     folderPath: 'silver/customers') ~> customers
source(output(
          account_id as string,
          customer_id as string,
          account_type as string,
          account_open_date as date,
          account_status as string,
          balance as decimal(10,0),
          branch_id as string
     ),
     allowSchemaDrift: true,
     validateSchema: false,
     ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
     format: 'delta',
     fileSystem: 'banking',
     folderPath: 'silver/accounts') ~> accounts
source(output(
          branch_id as string,
          branch_name as string,
          city as string,
          state as string,
          region as string
     ),
     allowSchemaDrift: true,
     validateSchema: false,
     ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
     format: 'delta',
     fileSystem: 'banking',
     folderPath: 'silver/branches') ~> branches
source(output(
          transaction_id as string,
          account_id as string,
          transaction_date as date,
          transaction_type as string,
          amount as decimal(10,0),
          payment_method as string,
          merchant as string,
          transaction_status as string
     ),
     allowSchemaDrift: true,
     validateSchema: false,
     ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
     format: 'delta',
     fileSystem: 'banking',
     folderPath: 'silver/transactions') ~> transactions
transactions, accounts join(transactions@account_id == accounts@account_id,
     joinType:'inner',
     matchType:'exact',
     ignoreSpaces: false,
     broadcast: 'auto')~> join1
join1, customers join(accounts@customer_id == customers@customer_id,
     joinType:'inner',
     matchType:'exact',
     ignoreSpaces: false,
     broadcast: 'auto')~> join2
join2, branches join(accounts@branch_id == branches@branch_id,
     joinType:'inner',
     matchType:'exact',
     ignoreSpaces: false,
     broadcast: 'auto')~> join3
join3 aggregate(groupBy(customers@customer_id),
     transaction_count = count(transaction_id),
          total_transaction_amount = sum(amount),
          average_transaction_amount = avg(amount),
          unique_transaction_types = countDistinct(transaction_type)) ~> aggregateTransactions
customers sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
     validateSchema: false,
     format: 'delta',
     fileSystem: 'banking',
     folderPath: 'gold/customers',
     overwrite: true,
     mergeSchema: false,
     autoCompact: false,
     optimizedWrite: false,
     vacuum: 0,
     deletable: false,
     insertable: true,
     updateable: false,
     upsertable: false,
     umask: 0022,
     preCommands: [],
     postCommands: [],
     skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
     skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> custdim
accounts sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
     validateSchema: false,
     format: 'delta',
     fileSystem: 'banking',
     folderPath: 'gold/accounts',
     overwrite: true,
     mergeSchema: false,
     autoCompact: false,
     optimizedWrite: false,
     vacuum: 0,
     deletable: false,
     insertable: true,
     updateable: false,
     upsertable: false,
     umask: 0022,
     preCommands: [],
     postCommands: [],
     skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
     skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> sinkdimaccount
branches sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
     validateSchema: false,
     format: 'delta',
     fileSystem: 'banking',
     folderPath: 'gold/branches',
     overwrite: true,
     mergeSchema: false,
     autoCompact: false,
     optimizedWrite: false,
     vacuum: 0,
     deletable: false,
     insertable: true,
     updateable: false,
     upsertable: false,
     umask: 0022,
     preCommands: [],
     postCommands: [],
     skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
     skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> sinkdimBranches
aggregateTransactions sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
     validateSchema: false,
     format: 'delta',
     fileSystem: 'banking',
     folderPath: 'gold/transactions',
     overwrite: true,
     mergeSchema: false,
     autoCompact: false,
     optimizedWrite: false,
     vacuum: 0,
     deletable: false,
     insertable: true,
     updateable: false,
     upsertable: false,
     umask: 0022,
     preCommands: [],
     postCommands: [],
     skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
     skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> customertransactionsummary
